findings.evidence: SturmTarski.lean:72-76; the goal after `rw [sign_mul, ← hs]` is `sign p' * (sign f * sign p') = sign f`, a pure SignType identity that `decide` settles.
findings.fix: Replace lines 72–76 with a decidable `SignType` lemma, e.g. `private theorem mul_mul_self (s t : SignType) (hs : s ≠ 0) : s * (t * s) = t := by revert hs; revert s t; decide`, then `rw [sign_mul, ← hs, mul_mul_self _ _ hd']`.
findings.issue: `generalize SignType.sign (p.derivative.eval r) = s at *` then `cases s <;> simp_all` then a *separate* trailing `simpa using congrArg Neg.neg hs.symm`. The proof only works because `simp_all` closes exactly two of the three `SignType` branches and leaves `hs` in exactly the shape the last line expects; any change to the default simp set silently breaks it in a way that is hard to repair.

findings.evidence: `grep -n '^\s*change '` over the new files: Jumps.lean:108,113,116,128; SturmSum.lean:160; SturmTarski.lean:107,115. All target `let`-bound names (`T`, `U`, `chain`, `d`).
findings.fix: Use `set T := S.filter (fun x => a < x ∧ x < b) with hT` (and likewise for `U`, `chain`) so hypotheses and goal are rewritten propositionally and no `change` is needed. In `tarski`, drop `let chain`/`let d` entirely: `obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, (p :: q :: cs).getLast? = some d := ⟨_, List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast (by simp)⟩` then `obtain ⟨ds, hmap, _, _, hreg⟩ := h.reduce hd`, giving an opaque `d` with no defeq juggling.
findings.issue: Seven `change` steps whose only purpose is to zeta-fold a tactic-local `let` so the goal displays the abbreviation. The attached comments say what the `change` does, not why the goal cannot be reached otherwise, and each rests on let-unfolding defeq. Sites: Jumps.lean:108, 113, 116, 128; SturmSum.lean:160; SturmTarski.lean:107 and 115 (the latter immediately undoes the fold done at 107, so the `let chain`/`let d` pair plus both `change`s accomplish nothing but naming `d`).

findings.evidence: SignedRemainders.lean:245 `simpa only [map_one, one_mul, mul_one, neg_mod, sub_neg_eq_add, mul_comm, add_comm] using (EuclideanDomain.mod_add_div p q).symm`; SturmTarski.lean:58 `simpa only [map_one, one_mul, mul_comm, add_comm] using ...`.
findings.fix: Discharge the arithmetic with `linear_combination`: e.g. `rw [map_one, one_mul, one_mul]; linear_combination (EuclideanDomain.mod_add_div p q)` (adding `neg_mod` as an explicit `rw` where needed), rather than letting `simp only` reorder products and sums.
findings.issue: Ring identities closed by `simpa only [..., mul_comm, add_comm] using ...`. Permutative rewrites depend on simp's internal term ordering reaching a common normal form; this breaks unpredictably. Also at SturmTarski.lean:58 (`TarskiSeed.mod`).

findings.evidence: SturmLocal.lean:62-65, 72-75, 117-121, 122-126 — identical modulo which of `har.le`/`hrb.le` and which interval-membership proof is supplied.
findings.fix: Extract one lemma, e.g. `theorem eval_sign_eq_of_isolated {p : R[X]} {a r b : R} (har : a < r) (hrb : r < b) (hpr : p.eval r ≠ 0) (hz : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, x ≠ r → p.eval x ≠ 0) : sign (p.eval a) = sign (p.eval r) ∧ sign (p.eval r) = sign (p.eval b)`, and call it at all four sites.
findings.issue: The same four-line block — `eval_sign_eq h.le (fun x hx => by by_cases hxr : x = r; · simpa [hxr] using h?; · exact hz ... hxr)` — is written out four times: lines 62-65 and 72-75 in `interior`, and 117-121 and 122-126 in `root_jump`. `root_signs`'s `hdz` (88-94) is a fifth variant.

findings.evidence: SturmSigns.lean:90-160; the `halt'` blocks at 125-132 and 147-154 differ only in `halt (i + 2)`/`halt (i + 1)` and one extra `List.getElem?_cons_succ`. `Regular.tail` (SturmLocal.lean:36-45) already performs exactly this shift for the bundled form.
findings.fix: Bundle the five hypotheses into a private predicate at point `r` (the same fields `Regular` carries, localized) and prove a single `tail` lemma shifting the index by one; then both branches are one or two applications of it. Add a leading comment stating the induction structure (collapse case vs. same case).
findings.issue: `signRelation_eval` is a 71-line proof with no structural comments, and its two branches each re-derive the same five hypotheses (`hne0'`, `hfront'`, `hlast'`, `halt'`, `hsame'`) for the tail, differing only in the index shift (+2 vs +1) — roughly 35 duplicated lines (118-139 vs 140-160).

findings.evidence: SturmTarski.lean:94-181 (88 lines); Jumps.lean:58-129 (72 lines). Both exceed the 50-line threshold with no global-structure commentary.
findings.fix: Extract the root-transfer step as a preliminary lemma (`∑ over p0.roots ∩ (a,b) of sign (f.eval ·) = ∑ over p.roots ∩ (a,b)` given `p = d * p0`, `hseed`, and simplicity), and have `Signed.reduce` return the already-split `∃ p0 q0 ds` form for a `p :: q :: cs` chain so the double `cases ds` and its two `simp [chain] at hmap` dead branches disappear. Add a two-line structure comment to `sum_jumps`.
findings.issue: `tarski` is an 88-line proof (94-181) whose only comments describe the `change` steps; the self-contained final third (152-181) — transferring the signed sum from the roots of `p0` to the roots of `p = d * p0`, using that `d`'s roots contribute zero — is never named. `Finset.sum_jumps` (Jumps.lean:58-129, 72 lines) likewise has no comment stating its strong-induction structure.

summary: The mathematical content is fine, but several proofs are written in brittle or unreadable ways: a `generalize ... at *` / `cases <;> simp_all` block whose trailing tactic depends on exactly which simp branches survive, seven `change` steps that exist only to fold `let`-bound abbreviations, permutative `simp only [mul_comm, add_comm]` closing ring identities, and ~35 lines of duplicated hypothesis re-derivation plus three 70–90 line proofs with no structural comments.
